vertical_motion.limit: These are source bone translation coordinates, not measured player world height or camera displacement. Native movement6FF9B0 samples the curve at700972/700AD6 but clears the Y term at700C6C for horizontal root-motion projection; airborne state2 separately applies action delta times actor stat+14 at700D70..700DA4.
